summary_en: 236,560 shares to be cancelled (2.64% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Effective date 2026-09-28. Post-cancellation issued share count: 8,733,440 shares. summary_en: Tender offer by Kindenden Co., Ltd. to acquire Kodensha Co., Ltd. at ¥11,501 per share. Minimum acceptance threshold 1,336,800 shares (66.67% post-acquisition). Offer period May 26–Jul 6, 2026 (30 business days). Target full subsidiary status and delisting. Board recommends shareholder acceptance.
